| Property      | Type                           | Required | Default  | Description                                                                                                   |
| ------------- | ------------------------------ | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `breakBefore` | `string \| expression<string>` | No       | `"auto"` | PDF only: Indicates whether to insert a page break before the component. Can be 'auto', 'always', or 'avoid'. |
| `breakAfter`  | `string \| expression<string>` | No       | `"auto"` | PDF only: Indicates whether to insert a page break after the component. Can be 'auto', 'always', or 'avoid'.  |
